name: Fody Foods Low FODMAP Sesame Ginger Sauce & Marinade
whyItWorks: Gluten-free tamari blended with toasted sesame oil, ginger puree, and organic raw sugar. Certified garlic and onion free, allowing patients to enjoy authentic stir-fries without triggering gas.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Pour 2 tablespoons over sliced chicken breast and zucchini in a hot skillet during the final 2 minutes of cooking.
